speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The Government assisted the affected farms following these plankton bloom and oil spill events.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: During the oil spill, AVA deployed oil absorbent pads and canvas to protect our farms.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA has put in place several measures to help our farmers manage longer-term environmental risks.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This helps them monitor water quality information like plankton counts and dissolved oxygen.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: AVA also provides short message service alerts to farmers when adverse conditions are detected so that precautionary measures can be taken.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Second, AVA continues to assist farmers in tailoring individual contingency plans.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: These technologies reduce the vulnerability of fish stocks to environmental risks.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Several farms have already adopted these systems and AVA continues to share these technologies with the rest of the industry through briefings and workshops.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Were there any affected farmers who did not avail themselves to the help that was given and, if so, is AVA aware of the reasons why, and is AVA looking into that?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: And are there some measures in place to have that complement the coastal fish farming and other types of fish farming?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Thirdly, is AVA exploring the possibility of deploying insurance products to help in risk-pooling among the farmers?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I am not sure if there is a possibility but has that been explored with the insurance sector and with the farms?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: For the first, I do not have the details as to who did not avail themselves of help.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: AVA, in the aftermath of both events, went out to all the farms and reached out to all the affected farms.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: As far as the oil spill is concerned, they went to all the farms in the eastern area and offered absorbent pads and canvas to help them screen off their stock.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: I am not sure if we are in a position to know who needed help and did not ask for it, and why they did not request for assistance.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: If the Member is aware of any farmer who did not seek assistance but requires it, please let us know.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: The second question was on vertical farming of fish.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: If the Member would be interested to know, there is a Tropical Marine Science Institute (TMSI) on St John's Island under the National University of Singapore and they work with AVA to explore various technologies and innovations that can help our fish farming industry progress and be more productive.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: I do not know specifically for a fact whether vertical fish farming is being contemplated.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But AVA is exploring with TMSI and other relevant institutes and agencies to explore various options for fish farmers to enhance their productivity.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: On the third question of insurance, a couple of years back, I did visit some fish farms and they did raise the issue of insurance to protect their stock.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: I think we start from measures that the fish farmers can put in place to protect their stock and these measures need to be seen in light of what AVA offers, for example, closed containment of cultured systems and other measures to help them protect their stock, out at sea, for instance.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Once they have put that in place, then, looking at the question of insurance, that is something that AVA is actively looking at.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It is not a straightforward matter because you need to have an adequate risk pool and insurers need to be assured that the farmers take appropriate self-help measures to reduce the risks.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But certainly, that is something that is being actively looked at.
